SELECT t.id as id, t.type_name as typeName, t.price as price, t.area as area, t.bed_type as bedType, t.max_guests as maxGuests, t.description as description, i.image_url as mainImage FROM (SELECT * FROM room_type WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY weight DESC, id ASC) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT room_type_id, MIN(image_url) as image_url FROM (SELECT room_type_id, image_url FROM room_type_image ORDER BY is_main DESC, id ASC) GROUP BY room_type_id) i ON t.id = i.room_type_id WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT id, type_name FROM room_type WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
